name: freertos_port_patch
description: Project copy of the FreeRTOS ARM_CM3 GCC port with the Wokwi PRIMASK/FAULTMASK workaround in prvPortStartFirstTask (see docs/dev-log.md). Not archived, so its port.o is linked as an object and the FreeRTOS library archive's own port.o is never pulled in; if any port symbol were missing here, the link would fail with a duplicate definition instead of silently using the unpatched port.
